name: อัครฆ้อง ผู้เก็บเสียงสุดท้าย
summary: A bronze funeral bell that mistook the last heartbeat in its sanctuary for a summons. Three readable phases: hammer, pursuing funeral procession and three-note range dance; broken seal adds chained ground echoes; naked core adds a second ranged note. Original model, procedural hand-painted textures, eleven animations and a copper-ringed octagonal bell sanctuary.
